name: @titanforge/monaco-bridge
description: Thin adapter wiring @titanforge/language-service into Monaco's provider APIs (completions/hover/diagnostics/definition) plus VFS<->Monaco-model content sync. Necessarily DOM/worker-coupled (Monaco requires a real browser environment) — kept deliberately thin, with the pure sync logic extracted and unit-tested separately from the Monaco-specific glue, matching this project's 'pure logic tested, DOM glue thin and less tested' convention.
